hint: Absolute value is the **distance** from $0$ on the number line. Distance is always positive (or zero).
explanation: Absolute value bars $|\;|$ ask for the distance from $0$.
$-7$ is $7$ units to the **left** of $0$ on the number line.

alternativeExplanations.title: Drop the sign
steps: Easy rule: $|x|$ takes off the negative sign if there is one.
